records.name: Living With Cancer Support Groups (Cancer Support Community Greater Philadelphia)
records.summary: Free support groups for adults living with any kind of cancer, run by Cancer Support Community Greater Philadelphia. Members meet weekly to talk about what daily life with cancer is like and to support one another.
records.what_you_do: Come to a weekly session, talk about treatment, work, family, and feelings, and hear what other members are dealing with. Sign up for each session in the online calendar.

schedule.text: Tuesdays at 11 am at the Suzanne Morgan Center at Ridgeland. A second weekly session meets Thursdays at 11:30 am at St. Mary Medical Center.

cost.text: Free. Programs are free for anyone affected by cancer, and a free member profile is needed.

first_step.how: Fill out the free member profile, then attend an orientation or a new member meeting. After that, sign up for a session in the online calendar.
first_step.basis: Anyone affected by cancer can join for free, but there is a short sign-up process first.

records.notes: The only dated text on the home page is a 2019 footer, which is not evidence, and the print calendars for September and October 2026 are linked as files that were not read. The online registration calendar (csc-gp.gnosishosting.net) did not show a program list when read. The Thursday session is at St. Mary Medical Center; the page gives no address for it. An earlier page read said registration requires membership; the how-to-join page says membership is free. The organization runs many other programs; only the Living With Cancer group is recorded here.

records.name: Laryngectomy Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly in-person group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people who have had a laryngectomy, which is surgery to remove the voice box. Members share how they are doing and learn from one another.
records.what_you_do: Attend the monthly meeting in person, ask questions about life after surgery, and hear from others who have been through it.

schedule.text: Fourth Thursday of each month, 2 to 3 pm, in person.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center, Main Campus (room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 and ask about the laryngectomy group before your first visit.
first_step.basis: Free and open to people treated elsewhere, with a published phone line to ask about joining.

records.notes: The group page has no dated program item; the 2026 copyright footer and rankings are not evidence. Eligibility is inferred from the group name. The support groups index says these groups are open to Fox Chase patients, their families, and people treated elsewhere. The registration contact on the page is a named staff member and is left out.

records.name: Breast Cancer Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly online group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for anyone with a breast cancer diagnosis. Members can share what they are going through or simply listen.
records.what_you_do: Join the video meeting on the second Wednesday of the month, share what is on your mind, or just listen to others.

schedule.text: Second Wednesday of each month, 12 to 1 pm, online.

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 to register. The page sends registration to a named staff contact, so the main line is the simplest way in.
first_step.basis: Open to anyone with a breast cancer diagnosis, with a published phone line.

records.notes: No dated program item on the page. The footer 2026 copyright is not evidence, and a schedule flyer link with 2021 in its file name was not used. Virtual only per the page.

records.name: Caregiver Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people who care for someone with cancer. It meets in person and online, so caregivers can connect with others doing the same work.
records.what_you_do: Come to the second Wednesday meeting in person or online, and talk with other caregivers about the hard parts and the small wins.

schedule.text: Second Wednesday of each month, 12 to 1 pm, in person or online.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center (in-person room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Register through the staff contact listed on the group page, or call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427.
first_step.basis: Open to anyone caring for a patient with cancer, with a published phone line.

records.notes: The page gives no room number, so the in-person location is the main campus address on the page. The page has no dated program item; footer copyright and rankings years are not evidence. This is a cancer caregiver group, separate from the Alzheimer's caregiver group in another record.

records.name: Bereavement Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people who lost a loved one in the past 12 months. Members meet in person or online to share their grief and support one another.
records.what_you_do: Come to the second Friday meeting in person or online, share what you are carrying, or listen to others who know the loss.

schedule.text: Second Friday of each month, 12 to 1 pm, in person and online.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center (in-person room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 to ask about joining the next meeting.
first_step.basis: Open to anyone who lost a loved one in the past 12 months, with a published phone line.

records.notes: The page says meetings are in person and virtual but gives no room. The footer 2026 copyright and rankings years are not evidence. This overlaps in topic with the grief lane; it is a separate hospital program.

records.name: Head and Neck Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly group for people who have finished or are in treatment for head and neck cancer. Family members are welcome. It meets in person and online at Fox Chase Cancer Center.
records.what_you_do: Come to the third Tuesday meeting in person or online, ask about treatment and recovery, and hear from others who have been through similar care.

schedule.text: Third Tuesday of each month, 12 to 1 pm, in person and online.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center (in-person room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: The page says registration is not required to come in person. For online details, call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 and ask for the Zoom link.
first_step.basis: No registration is needed for in-person meetings, and family members are welcome.

records.notes: The page does not say which room the in-person meetings use; the campus address is the main campus address on the page. The group description has no date. The copyright footer and rankings years are not evidence.

records.name: Prostate Cancer Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly group for anyone diagnosed with prostate cancer. Most meetings have a speaker on a topic, and members share information and support. It meets in person at Fox Chase Cancer Center with a Zoom option.
records.what_you_do: Come to the second Thursday meeting in person or on Zoom, listen to the speaker, ask questions, and talk with others. Light refreshments are served.

schedule.text: Second Thursday of each month, 6:30 to 7:45 pm, in person with a Zoom option. The page lists 2026 dates from January to December, marks June and October as no meeting, and names topics for some months.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center (room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the urology office at 215-728-1111 for information and to register, or use the Zoom link on the page.
first_step.basis: Open to anyone with a prostate cancer diagnosis, with a published office number and a Zoom option.

records.notes: The group's own calendar lists 2026 meeting dates, including September 10, an October 8 entry marked as no meeting, November 12 and December 10. The room is not stated. The urology office line is for information and registration, and the page gives a Zoom link (not recorded).

records.name: Gastrointestinal Cancers Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: An online group for people in treatment for a gastrointestinal cancer, led by social workers from Fox Chase Cancer Center. It meets four times a year, in March, June, September, and December.
records.what_you_do: Join the online session with a social worker and other people in treatment, and talk about what you are facing.

schedule.text: Third Wednesday of March, June, September, and December, 4 to 5 pm, online.

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Contact the group's staff through the page to register and get the Zoom link, or call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427.
first_step.basis: Registration goes through a staff contact, and the page limits the group to people who are currently in treatment.

records.notes: Only dated text is the 2026 copyright and award graphics, which are not evidence. The page does not state who can join beyond people currently in treatment.

records.name: Melanoma Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly in-person group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people affected by melanoma. The page says it helps members feel less alone, cope better, and talk more easily with their care team and loved ones.
records.what_you_do: Come to the third Wednesday meeting in person, learn coping skills, and talk with others who know what melanoma is like.

schedule.text: Third Wednesday of each month, 3 to 4 pm, in person. The full schedule is in a linked flyer.

locations.label: Fox Chase Cancer Center (room not stated)

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Registration is handled by a named staff contact on the page. Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 to ask how to sign up.
first_step.basis: The page does not say who is eligible, and registration goes through a staff contact.

records.notes: The page does not state who the group is for; the name points to melanoma, so the summary says people affected by it. The only dated item is the footer copyright, which is not evidence. The schedule flyer was linked but not read.

records.name: Lymphedema Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people living with lymphedema, the swelling that can follow cancer treatment. It meets about four times a year, with a new topic each time, and a light dinner is served.
records.what_you_do: Come to a quarterly evening session on one topic, eat a light dinner, and talk with others who are living with lymphedema.

schedule.text: Quarterly, 6:30 to 8 pm, in person. The page lists meeting dates as to be decided, so call before you go.

locations.label: Outpatient Area B, fireplace lounge, Fox Chase Cancer Center

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page. A light dinner is served.

first_step.how: Call 215-728-7000 to hear the topics and register.
first_step.basis: Open to the public with a published phone number, though dates are set by phone.

records.notes: The page says the meeting day and dates are TBD, so the schedule is approximate. The page does not state who the group is for beyond people with lymphedema. The footer 2026 copyright is not evidence.

records.name: Esophagectomy Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly online group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people with esophageal cancer who are thinking about surgery or have already had it.
records.what_you_do: Join the online meeting on the third Wednesday, ask questions about surgery and recovery, and hear from others who have been through the same operation.

schedule.text: Third Wednesday of each month, 1 to 2 pm, online. The page lists 2026 meetings from February 18 through December 16.

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 or contact the staff listed on the page to register.
first_step.basis: Clear about who it is for, with a published phone line and a registration step.

records.notes: The page lists the 2026 meeting dates from February 18 through December 16, and the earliest of those is used as the sign-of-life month. A named staff contact handles registration and is left out.

records.name: Sarcoma Support Group, STORIES (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A free online group for people with sarcoma, whether they are treated at Fox Chase or somewhere else. It meets four times a year, in January, April, July, and October.
records.what_you_do: Join the online meeting on the last Wednesday of the month, share your experience, and learn from others who have sarcoma.

schedule.text: Last Wednesday of January, April, July, and October, 5 to 6 pm, online. The page lists April 29, July 29, and October 28, 2026.

first_step.how: Register through the staff contact on the page, or call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427.
first_step.basis: Open to all sarcoma patients, whether treated at Fox Chase or elsewhere, and free.

records.notes: The page lists the 2026 meetings on April 29, July 29, and October 28. The January entry has no year and is not used. The acronym STORIES stands for the group's full name on the page.

records.name: Neuroendocrine Tumor Support Group (Fox Chase Cancer Center)
records.summary: A monthly online group at Fox Chase Cancer Center for people with neuroendocrine tumors. Members learn coping skills and get support from others, which can help with loneliness and worry.
records.what_you_do: Join the online meeting on the third Wednesday, 4 to 5 pm, to talk with others and learn coping skills.

schedule.text: Third Wednesday of each month, 4 to 5 pm, online.

cost.text: Free, per the Fox Chase support group page

first_step.how: Call the Fox Chase main line at 888-369-2427 or register through the staff contact on the page.
first_step.basis: The page does not say who can join, and registration goes through staff contacts.

records.notes: The group page is on the Fox Chase site outside the usual support group path. Its only dated item is the footer copyright, which is not evidence. Eligibility is not stated.

records.name: W.I.S.E. Aging and HIV Peer Resource Group (Mazzoni Center)
records.summary: An eight-week peer group for adults around age 65 who have HIV. Members meet weekly at Mazzoni Center to talk about health topics such as nutrition, exercise, and sexual health, and to build a support network.
records.what_you_do: Join the weekly sessions with other members, hear from people who lead each topic, and build community with others your age who are living with HIV.

schedule.text: Tuesdays, 1 to 3 pm, for an eight-week cohort. The page lists September 22 through November 10 with no year written.

first_step.how: Register through the online sign-up form linked on the group page, or call the Bainbridge main line for help.
first_step.basis: Joins through a sign-up form, and the page does not describe what the first session is like.

records.notes: The cohort dates (September 22 to November 10, with a September 15 sign-up deadline) appear without a year, so the status stays unknown. Confirm the current cohort before it goes live. The page does not say the group is only for LGBTQ people, so no community tag was added. The phone number is Mazzoni's Bainbridge main line.

records.name: LEAD Health Advocacy Group (Mazzoni Center)
records.summary: An eight-week group for LGBTQ+ young adults ages 18 to 24. It covers mental, physical, and sexual health, helps members build community, and helps them manage their own health care.
records.what_you_do: Attend the weekly sessions at Mazzoni Center's Bainbridge Street building, learn about health, and meet other young adults. Sessions include pizza and SEPTA passes, and people who finish get a $100 gift card.

schedule.text: Eight-week cohorts. The next cohort listed on the page starts Tuesday, September 1, 2026, 5:30 to 7 pm.

cost.text: Not stated. Participants receive a $100 gift card for finishing, plus SEPTA passes and pizza at sessions.

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form linked on the page, or email the Mazzoni Center education team with questions.
first_step.basis: Starts with an interest form before each cohort, and the page gives little detail about what the first session is like.

records.notes: The page names September 1, 2026 as the next cohort, which has already started, and shows no later cohort, so confirm the next start date. The sessions are described as weekly with meals and SEPTA passes. The education team email is a group address, not a person's address.

records.name: Affirming Hearts Academy (Mazzoni Center)
records.summary: A free eight-week group for LGBTQ+ adults, 18 and older, about healthy and affirming relationships. It looks at romantic, friendship, family, and work connections.
records.what_you_do: Join the weekly group for eight weeks, talk about what healthy relationships look like, and take home journals, art supplies, SEPTA passes, and snacks.

schedule.text: Eight weekly sessions. The next group starts September 22, 2026. Meeting days and times are not stated.

cost.text: Free, with journals, art supplies, SEPTA passes, and snacks provided

first_step.how: Fill out the interest form linked on the group page. For general questions, call the Bainbridge main line.
first_step.basis: Joins through an interest form, and the page does not give meeting times yet.

records.notes: The page says the next group starts September 22, 2026, and gives no meeting days or times. Confirm the day and time before attending. Mazzoni's Bainbridge main line is the contact.

records.name: New Mom Circle (Invictus Physical Therapy, hosted by Baby Gear Group)
records.summary: A free weekly meetup for new moms and birthing people whose babies are about the same age. It meets at Invictus Physical Therapy on North 20th Street and is aimed at families with babies who are not crawling yet. Coffee, donuts, and fruit are provided.
records.what_you_do: Come to the weekly circle to meet other new parents and share what is going on. A special free session on mommy and me yoga and infant massage is listed for a December date.

schedule.text: Weekly on Tuesdays, 10 to 11 am. The page gives an Oct 28 start and a special session on Tuesday, Dec 9 at 11 am, with no year written.

locations.label: Invictus Physical Therapy, second floor (stroller friendly, elevator)

first_step.how: Just come on a Tuesday. The page also links an optional sign-up form so the host can plan refreshments, and people are still welcome if they forget to sign up.
first_step.basis: The page welcomes all parents by name, the sign-up is optional, and people can still come if they forget to register.

records.notes: The page was published October 23, 2025 and updated December 4, 2025. The Oct 28 start and Dec 9 session have no year written, so confirm the current schedule with the host before attending. A roundup said Logan Square, but the page gives 100 N 20th St, which is used here. The phone and email are Baby Gear Group's general contact lines, not a person's. The organization is a physical therapy practice that hosts this free community group.

records.what_you_do: Attend the monthly meeting to share and listen with others who have a loved one in prison. The ministry also runs a pen pal program and a transition team for people coming home.

schedule.text: Second Thursday of each month, 7 pm, as listed in a 2021 article. Confirm before going.

locations.label: St. Charles Borromeo Parish meeting room

notes: Budget: all 3 WebSearch calls used (hard cap reached), about 57 WebFetch calls used of 60. Records: 18 publish, 0 other verdicts. Kutest Kids M.O.T.H.E.R.S. group (only an April 2023 article; the Kutest Kids site no longer mentions it, so it could be recorded as dormant if the owner wants). While We Wait, Rhetta Morgan (only evidence is a November 2014 article and a Facebook event). Pennsylvania Prison Society family support (a helpline and services page, not a group; its phone and hours are on its families page if the owner wants a helpline entry). Attic Youth Center (youth events dated October 9 and 12, 2026, but none described as a support or peer group). Mazzoni Youth Drop-In Clinic (a medical drop-in clinic, not a support group).
